requiredFindings.title: Handle the operation end outcome instead of dropping its failures
requiredFindings.finding: The seam unconditionally drops operation.end(JournalOutcome::Certain), then returns the discovery records. OperationEnd explicitly includes Failed(EndFailure) and RolledOver { end: Err(..), .. }; its contract says failures are disclosed by the caller. The existing commit_session end_step_failure/rollover projections demonstrate this distinction. Thus an end-path fence, owner, carrier or unlock refusal can disappear, and an ordinary successful-looking DiscoveryRecords value is still returned. This conflicts with the seam's stated non-discovery-refusals-as-Err behavior and fails to preserve the full planned operation/end composition.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Match and handle OperationEnd, including failed end steps after rollover and any required rollover disclosure. Preserve the original discovery outcome as required by the end contract; report the separate end failure through Err or an explicit plain end-disclosure field rather than silently dropping it. NotEntered is not itself a failure. Add a focused control that an end failure remains observable and cannot be mistaken for clean completion, without adding a new shared fixture gate.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: The if-let-Ok boundary_inventory projection also suppresses Locator instrument faults. NotAccepted is expected for a refused discovery result; on an accepted result, require inventory conversion to succeed or return Err, rather than quietly producing inventory=None. Current valid walker outputs should not hit Locator, but keeping that invariant visible makes the seam a stronger control.
